skills.name: hop-top-kit
skills.description: Pick which kit port to build with: Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust or PHP, or the kit binary as a sidecar for any other language. Use when choosing a language or SDK for a tool built on kit, when adding kit to an existing project, when asked which port supports a capability, or when a port lacks a capability the task needs. Not for writing code with one port: load that port's skill for that.

skills.name: hop-top-kit-go
skills.description: Build with kit's Go reference implementation (module hop.top/kit), the kit binary and kit init scaffolding. Use when writing or changing Go code that imports hop.top/kit, when scaffolding a new CLI with kit init, when running the kit binary as a sidecar for a non-Go tool, or when a task needs a capability only Go has. Not for TypeScript, Python, Rust or PHP code: pick the port with the hop-top-kit router.

skills.name: hop-top-kit-py
skills.description: Build a CLI or service in Python on kit with the hop-top-kit package (import hop_top_kit): Typer app factory, output formats, layered config, serve lifecycle, MCP surface, guardrails, migrations. Use when Python code imports hop_top_kit or the user asks for kit in Python, when choosing between kit modules in this port, or when checking whether this port covers a capability before building on it. Not for choosing a language: use the hop-top-kit router for that.

skills.name: hop-top-kit-php
skills.description: Build a PHP CLI with the experimental kit PHP port (Composer package hop-top/kit, namespace HopTop\Kit). Use when PHP code requires hop-top/kit, when adding kit's output formats, MCP surface or serve lifecycle to a PHP tool, or when asked whether the PHP port can do something. Most kit capabilities are absent from this port: it says what exists and when to switch to another port or the kit sidecar.
